Apotheosis (Quest)#000.src: Head to {p} and find your friends at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Apotheosis (Quest)#000.dst: Vá até {p} e encontre seus amigos em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Apotheosis (Quest)#001.src: Fight through {p} and find your friends.
Apotheosis (Quest)#001.dst: Abra caminho por {p} e encontre seus amigos.

Apotheosis (Quest)#002.src: Ha. Your bow control is sloppy, ''captain.''
Apotheosis (Quest)#002.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#006.src: Thanks for the support, {u}! Not sure how much longer I could've held out on my own.
Apotheosis (Quest)#006.dst: Valeu pelo apoio, {u}! Não sei quanto tempo mais eu aguentaria sozinha.
Apotheosis (Quest)#006.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#007.src: We were about to regroup with the Canopy, but Cileon spotted soldiers approaching through the hotel windows.
Apotheosis (Quest)#007.dst: Íamos nos reunir com o Dossel, mas Cileon viu soldados chegando pelas janelas do hotel.
Apotheosis (Quest)#007.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#008.src: They've stormed the plaza, and probably the rest of the city by now... I think they've rounded up all the citizens at the festival grounds.
Apotheosis (Quest)#008.dst: Eles tomaram a praça, e a esta altura o resto da cidade... Acho que juntaram todos os cidadãos no recinto do festival.
Apotheosis (Quest)#008.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#009.src: We all got split up in the commotion - the others are probably fighting their own battles! Come on, we need to get moving!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#009.dst: A gente se separou na confusão - os outros devem estar lutando suas próprias batalhas! Vamos, precisamos nos mexer!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#009.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#011.src: Find the rest of your friends in {p}.
Apotheosis (Quest)#011.dst: Encontre o resto dos seus amigos em {p}.

Apotheosis (Quest)#013.src: Phew... th...that was close. {u}, it's g- good to see you.
Apotheosis (Quest)#013.dst: Ufa... f...foi por pouco. {u}, que b- bom te ver.
Apotheosis (Quest)#013.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#014.src: Where are the others? Have you seen them?
Apotheosis (Quest)#014.dst: Cadê os outros? Você os viu?
Apotheosis (Quest)#014.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#015.src: I saw Cileon u- up ahead! But I l- lo- lost sight of Sui a while ago...
Apotheosis (Quest)#015.dst: Vi Cileon l- lá na frente! Mas p- per- perdi Sui de vista faz tempo...
Apotheosis (Quest)#015.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#016.src: Then what are we waiting for?! Let's get moving!
Apotheosis (Quest)#016.dst: Então estamos esperando o quê?! Vamos!
Apotheosis (Quest)#016.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#018.src: ...{u}, if y...you're here, then... the Queen...?
Apotheosis (Quest)#018.dst: ...{u}, se v...você está aqui... a Rainha...?
Apotheosis (Quest)#018.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#019.src: Worry about our friends first, Queen second! Come one, move move move!
Apotheosis (Quest)#019.dst: Primeiro os amigos, depois a Rainha! Vamos, anda, anda, anda!
Apotheosis (Quest)#019.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#024.src: Th...that was awesome, Cileon!! Could you t- te- teach me some of your techni-
Apotheosis (Quest)#024.dst: I...isso foi incrível, Cileon!! Pode me e- en- ensinar umas técni-
Apotheosis (Quest)#024.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#025.src: ZEPH! There's no TIME!! Cileon, have you seen Sui?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#025.dst: ZEPH! Não dá TEMPO!! Cileon, viu a Sui?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#025.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#033.src: Sui, that was i- in- incredible!! But, using that much m...magic... be careful not to use up all of your st- strength...
Apotheosis (Quest)#033.dst: Sui, isso foi i- in- incrível!! Mas usar tanta m...magia... cuidado para não gastar toda a sua f- força...
Apotheosis (Quest)#033.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#034.src: ...it's fine, Zeph. It doesn't drain me to use, anymore. I can just... pull on the strands.
Apotheosis (Quest)#034.dst: ...tudo bem, Zeph. Usar não me cansa mais. Eu só... puxo os fios.
Apotheosis (Quest)#034.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#036.src: R- ri- right... the festival speech. Should we try to l...listen in on it?
Apotheosis (Quest)#036.dst: C- cer- certo... o discurso do festival. Vamos tentar o...ouvir?
Apotheosis (Quest)#036.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#037.src: What?! No! We're all safe, so let's get out of here and regroup with the rest of the Canopy! Doing anything else is way too risky-
Apotheosis (Quest)#037.dst: O quê?! Não! Estamos salvos, então vamos sair daqui e nos reunir com o resto do Dossel! Qualquer outra coisa é arriscado demais-
Apotheosis (Quest)#037.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#038.src: No. I'm... I'm done running away. We're going in.
Apotheosis (Quest)#038.dst: Não. Eu... cansei de fugir. Nós vamos entrar.
Apotheosis (Quest)#038.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#040.src: She's responsible for everything that has happened to us. I'm not going to just... let her get away when she's RIGHT THERE!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#040.dst: Ela é culpada de tudo o que aconteceu com a gente. Não vou só... deixá-la escapar quando está BEM ALI!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#040.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#041.src: She's going to pay for all of it.
Apotheosis (Quest)#041.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#042.src: S- Sui... you don't h- have to do it alone.
Apotheosis (Quest)#042.dst: S- Sui... você não p- precisa ir sozinha.
Apotheosis (Quest)#042.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#043.src: ...fine. Fine! Let's do it, then! Let's go... face the Queen.
Apotheosis (Quest)#043.dst: ...tá. Tá! Então vamos! Vamos... encarar a Rainha.
Apotheosis (Quest)#043.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#044.src: Make your way to the festival grounds at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Apotheosis (Quest)#044.dst: Vá até o recinto do festival em [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Apotheosis (Quest)#048.src: ...th- this was a bad idea. We n...need to get out of-
Apotheosis (Quest)#048.dst: ...i- isso foi má ideia. P...precisamos sair de-
Apotheosis (Quest)#048.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#049.src: People of the {p}! I deeply apologize for the disruption to your routines. You must be confused, afraid.
Apotheosis (Quest)#049.dst: Povo de {p}! Peço profundas desculpas por perturbar sua rotina. Devem estar confusos, com medo.
Apotheosis (Quest)#049.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#050.src: This festival is a time for joy, for celebration! But there are those within your midst who reject this notion. They aim to bring destruction, chaos!
Apotheosis (Quest)#050.dst: Este festival é tempo de alegria, de celebração! Mas há entre vocês quem rejeite essa ideia. Querem trazer destruição, caos!
Apotheosis (Quest)#050.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#051.src: Indeed... a plot to twist our province's ideals, to destroy our very way of life! The perpetrators lurking in your city, feigning innocence... what a disgrace.
Apotheosis (Quest)#051.dst: De fato... uma trama para distorcer os ideais da província, destruir nosso modo de vida! Os culpados se escondem na cidade, fingindo inocência... que vergonha.
Apotheosis (Quest)#051.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#052.src: It was your very own Sovereign, Majin Thalas, whose quick thinking brought down the terrorists' plot! The Wings, the Constables, the Local Guard, all have mobilized to capture the perpetrators.
Apotheosis (Quest)#052.dst: Foi seu próprio Soberano, Majin Thalas, quem com rapidez desfez a trama terrorista! As Asas, os Condestáveis, a Guarda Local, todos se mobilizaram para capturar os culpados.
Apotheosis (Quest)#052.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#053.src: Soon, we shall have them chained before you. Soon, you shall see the faces of this blight, this infection in the veins of our province.
Apotheosis (Quest)#053.dst: Em breve os teremos acorrentados diante de vocês. Em breve verão o rosto desta praga, desta infecção nas veias da nossa província.
Apotheosis (Quest)#053.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#054.src: And soon, we shall cut. It. Out.
Apotheosis (Quest)#054.dst: E logo a arrancaremos. De. Vez.
Apotheosis (Quest)#054.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#055.src: Listen to Her Majesty and her Sovereigns.
Apotheosis (Quest)#055.dst: Ouça Sua Majestade e seus Soberanos.

Apotheosis (Quest)#058.src: And so it would seem my Sovereigns have once again failed to perform what should be a very simple task.
Apotheosis (Quest)#058.dst: E então parece que meus Soberanos mais uma vez falharam no que devia ser uma tarefa muito simples.
Apotheosis (Quest)#058.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#059.src: Sovereign Thalas, what, precisely, is it you have been teaching these soldiers of yours?! Because there should be no reason for them to have FAILED to capture these CHILDREN!
Apotheosis (Quest)#059.dst: Soberano Thalas, o que, exatamente, você tem ensinado a esses seus soldados?! Pois não há motivo para terem FALHADO em capturar estas CRIANÇAS!
Apotheosis (Quest)#059.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#060.src: I told you we should've taken the direct solution! More dead soldiers, more of our people subtracted out, for nothing!
Apotheosis (Quest)#060.dst: Eu disse que devíamos ter tomado a solução direta! Mais soldados mortos, mais gente nossa subtraída, por nada!
Apotheosis (Quest)#060.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Apotheosis (Quest)#061.src: Hm! Now, let us be clear, the soldiers are-
Apotheosis (Quest)#061.dst: Hm! Ora, sejamos claros, os soldados são-
Apotheosis (Quest)#061.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#062.src: Oh, I do not care. Save your excuses.
Apotheosis (Quest)#062.dst: Ah, não importa. Guarde as desculpas.
Apotheosis (Quest)#062.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#063.src: I have given you more than enough chances to realise the weight of what it is we do!
Apotheosis (Quest)#063.dst: Já lhes dei chances de sobra para entenderem o peso do que fazemos!
Apotheosis (Quest)#063.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#064.src: You... you have proven very hard to pin down, it would seem. No matter the circumstances, you have a knack for slipping through the cracks...
Apotheosis (Quest)#064.dst: Você... você se mostrou bem difícil de pegar, ao que parece. Seja qual for a situação, você tem um dom para escapar pelas frestas...
Apotheosis (Quest)#064.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#065.src: It would be oh so simple to blame you for all you have enacted... but the truth is, you were merely the catalyst. The seeds of this rebellion were planted long, long before you.
Apotheosis (Quest)#065.dst: Seria tão simples culpar você por tudo que fez... mas a verdade é que você foi só o catalisador. As sementes desta rebelião foram plantadas muito, muito antes de você.
Apotheosis (Quest)#065.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#066.src: Oh, the {p}... over these centuries, its beauty has never faded. The vibrant colors, the warm breeze of the changing seasons...
Apotheosis (Quest)#066.dst: Ah, {p}... ao longo dos séculos, sua beleza nunca se apagou. As cores vivas, a brisa morna das estações que mudam...
Apotheosis (Quest)#066.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#067.src: What a shame, then, that beneath the cover of the leaves, there lurk countless cowering pests. And no matter how hard I try, I cannot seem to wash them out.
Apotheosis (Quest)#067.dst: Que pena, então, que sob o manto das folhas se escondam inúmeras pragas covardes. E por mais que eu tente, não consigo varrê-las.
Apotheosis (Quest)#067.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#068.src: Fell the perceived source of their strength, cut the branches and burn the leaves, the fruit that emboldens their acts - and still, they persist!
Apotheosis (Quest)#068.dst: Derrubar a suposta fonte de sua força, cortar os galhos e queimar as folhas, o fruto que inflama seus atos - e ainda assim, persistem!
Apotheosis (Quest)#068.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#069.src: Bury their monuments, erase their gods - and still, and STILL, they cling to ideals of love, of family! And still, and still, and still, they persist.
Apotheosis (Quest)#069.dst: Enterrar seus monumentos, apagar seus deuses - e ainda, e AINDA, se agarram a ideais de amor, de família! E ainda, e ainda, e ainda, persistem.
Apotheosis (Quest)#069.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#070.src: Washing it all away had shown results... for a time. But even growing forth from a blank slate, even with no ties to what came before - still, still, STILL THEY PERSIST!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#070.dst: Afogar tudo deu resultado... por um tempo. Mas mesmo brotando do zero, sem laços com o que veio antes - ainda, ainda, AINDA ASSIM PERSISTEM!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#070.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#071.src: There is a rot in the heart of that forest. I see that now. Perhaps, I had allowed my fondness for the region to blind me... but no more.
Apotheosis (Quest)#071.dst: Há podridão no coração daquela floresta. Agora vejo. Talvez eu tenha deixado meu apreço pela região me cegar... mas chega.
Apotheosis (Quest)#071.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#072.src: And so, as once we saw out the New Age, so again shall we wash away these pests. That accursed forest will drown, and the rot buried deep will be excised once more.
Apotheosis (Quest)#072.dst: E assim, como um dia encerramos a Nova Era, de novo varreremos estas pragas. Aquela floresta maldita vai se afogar, e a podridão enterrada será extirpada outra vez.
Apotheosis (Quest)#072.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#074.src: W-With respect, that is not a viable angle! The Resistance is such a small percentage of the overall population, they're practically a rounding error!
Apotheosis (Quest)#074.dst: C-Com respeito, essa não é uma abordagem viável! A Resistência é uma porcentagem tão pequena da população que é quase um erro de arredondamento!
Apotheosis (Quest)#074.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Apotheosis (Quest)#075.src: You can't divide out a quarter of our province's people, a-and just as much infrastructure, just to solve for a subset of rogue integers!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#075.dst: Não pode dividir um quarto da população, e-e igual parte da infraestrutura, só para resolver um subconjunto de inteiros rebeldes!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#075.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Apotheosis (Quest)#076.src: Learn when to keep your mouth shut, would you, Nasin?! We are standing before the public! This is not the time to raise such grievances-
Apotheosis (Quest)#076.dst: Aprenda quando calar a boca, sim, Nasin?! Estamos diante do público! Não é hora de levantar essas queixas-
Apotheosis (Quest)#076.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#077.src: That didn't stop you interrupting my sequence and openly denigrating the recruits at the tournament to fulfill your petty factoring grudge!! You have no excuses!
Apotheosis (Quest)#077.dst: Isso não o impediu de interromper minha sequência e humilhar os recrutas no torneio para saciar seu mesquinho rancor fatorado!! Você não tem desculpa!
Apotheosis (Quest)#077.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Apotheosis (Quest)#078.src: We- We have been wasting our numbers at every point. When did our vector shift to something so shortsighted? When did we lose sight of our nontrivial solution?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#078.dst: N- Nós desperdiçamos nossos números em todo ponto. Quando nosso vetor mudou para algo tão míope? Quando perdemos de vista nossa solução não trivial?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#078.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Apotheosis (Quest)#079.src: You're both plugged into a destructive sequence! I can't enable these irrationalities!! I refuse to be a variable in this cyclical, downwards spiral!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#079.dst: Vocês dois estão numa sequência destrutiva! Não posso validar essas irracionalidades!! Recuso-me a ser variável nesta espiral cíclica descendente!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#079.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Apotheosis (Quest)#080.src: Take care with what you do next, Zhiraok Nasin. If you turn away now, you will forsake your position and forfeit your life.
Apotheosis (Quest)#080.dst: Cuidado com o que fará agora, Zhiraok Nasin. Se der as costas agora, abrirá mão do cargo e perderá a vida.
Apotheosis (Quest)#080.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#083.src: If this is what honor is supposed to feel like, I don't want it anymore.
Apotheosis (Quest)#083.dst: Se a honra deve ser assim, eu não a quero mais.
Apotheosis (Quest)#083.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Apotheosis (Quest)#084.src: My loyalty is to the people. If yours isn't, then our vectors no longer converge. I'm subtracting my pact to you myself.
Apotheosis (Quest)#084.dst: Minha lealdade é ao povo. Se a sua não é, nossos vetores não convergem mais. Eu mesmo subtraio meu pacto com você.
Apotheosis (Quest)#084.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Apotheosis (Quest)#085.src: Gotta evacuate, contact Xao, the commanders, get everyone to higher ground, find where the helix S-
Apotheosis (Quest)#085.dst: Preciso evacuar, avisar Xao, os comandantes, levar todos para o alto, achar onde a hélice S-
Apotheosis (Quest)#085.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Apotheosis (Quest)#086.src: Hmph! Your Majesty, if you would allow it, I would gladly put his head on a stick for you.
Apotheosis (Quest)#086.dst: Hmpf! Majestade, se me permite, com prazer lhe trago a cabeça dele numa estaca.
Apotheosis (Quest)#086.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#087.src: Firstly, Sovereign Thalas, I would have you clean up your mess. Execute the terrorists.
Apotheosis (Quest)#087.dst: Primeiro, Soberano Thalas, quero que limpe sua bagunça. Execute os terroristas.
Apotheosis (Quest)#087.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#088.src: ...and once you are done, you have my approval to hunt down ex-Sovereign Zhiraok Nasin.
Apotheosis (Quest)#088.dst: ...e quando terminar, tem minha permissão para caçar o ex-Soberano Zhiraok Nasin.
Apotheosis (Quest)#088.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#089.src: While you are at it, eliminate that entire House. They have disappointed me far too many times, and I have granted them far too many chances.
Apotheosis (Quest)#089.dst: Aproveite e elimine aquela Casa inteira. Já me decepcionaram vezes demais, e já lhes dei chances demais.
Apotheosis (Quest)#089.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#090.src: Aha! Gladly. As you wish, Your Majesty. It will be done.
Apotheosis (Quest)#090.dst: Ahá! Com prazer. Como quiser, Majestade. Será feito.
Apotheosis (Quest)#090.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#091.src: Sovereign Tasim. You will be coming with me to the dam.
Apotheosis (Quest)#091.dst: Soberano Tasim. Você virá comigo à represa.
Apotheosis (Quest)#091.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#094.src: Ahhh... Finally! I'd long been awaiting the day I'd get the chance to wipe you rats off the face of the planet.
Apotheosis (Quest)#094.dst: Ahhh... Finalmente! Há muito eu esperava o dia de varrer vocês, ratos, da face do planeta.
Apotheosis (Quest)#094.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#095.src: But before we begin, I'm an honourable man, so I'll grant you this opportunity! Any last words for the crowd?
Apotheosis (Quest)#095.dst: Mas antes, sou um homem honrado, então lhes darei esta oportunidade! Últimas palavras para o público?
Apotheosis (Quest)#095.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#096.src: Ahahahaha! Did you, now? That the great Sovereign Majin would fall to a simple group of insurgents... What a laughably fanciful tale!
Apotheosis (Quest)#096.dst: Ahahahaha! É mesmo? Que o grande Soberano Majin cairia diante de um mero bando de insurgentes... Que conto risivelmente fantasioso!
Apotheosis (Quest)#096.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#097.src: My goodness, what a statement! You truly believe so? That you of all people stand a chance against my might?
Apotheosis (Quest)#097.dst: Minha nossa, que declaração! Acredita mesmo? Que justo você tem chance contra o meu poder?
Apotheosis (Quest)#097.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#098.src: Oh, how dreadfully dull. If you are going to be so dramatic, use a better line, would you?
Apotheosis (Quest)#098.dst: Ah, que terrivelmente tedioso. Se vai ser tão dramático, use uma fala melhor, sim?
Apotheosis (Quest)#098.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#099.src: Ha! As if. Half those tabloids are filled with naught but meaningless gossip! Though, I do have an appreciation for the Majin Monthly. It's quite the interesting read, you know!
Apotheosis (Quest)#099.dst: Ha! Até parece. Metade desses tabloides é pura fofoca sem sentido! Embora eu aprecie a Majin Mensal. É uma leitura bem interessante, sabe!
Apotheosis (Quest)#099.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#100.src: Hm... But I'm afraid only one of you is worthy of facing me in combat. As for the rest of you pitiful worms...
Apotheosis (Quest)#100.dst: Hm... Mas temo que só um de vocês seja digno de me enfrentar. Quanto ao resto de vocês, vermes lamentáveis...
Apotheosis (Quest)#100.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#102.src: Ah ah ah! Keep your eyes on what's important, mmn?
Apotheosis (Quest)#102.dst: Ah ah ah! Olhos no que importa, hmm?
Apotheosis (Quest)#102.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#103.src: You should feel honoured! Very few are given the privilege of dying to my blade. I'd tell you to write about it in your memoirs, but...
Apotheosis (Quest)#103.dst: Devia se sentir honrado! Poucos têm o privilégio de morrer pela minha lâmina. Eu diria para escrever isso nas suas memórias, mas...
Apotheosis (Quest)#103.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#104.src: Well, I don't imagine you'll have the chance. NOW -
Apotheosis (Quest)#104.dst: Bem, acho que não terá a chance. AGORA -
Apotheosis (Quest)#104.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#105.src: Defeat Majin. To return to the fight, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Apotheosis (Quest)#105.dst: Derrote Majin. Para voltar à luta, vá até [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Apotheosis (Quest)#106.src: Welcome to my domain of the starry night, dear guest! Quite the stunning view, is it not?
Apotheosis (Quest)#106.dst: Bem-vindo ao meu domínio da noite estrelada, caro convidado! Que vista deslumbrante, não?
Apotheosis (Quest)#106.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#107.src: By all means - take your time, take it all in, every little detail! Allow that feeling to sink in - your sheer insignificance in the face of the vastness of the cosmos!
Apotheosis (Quest)#107.dst: Fique à vontade - leve seu tempo, absorva tudo, cada detalhe! Deixe esse sentimento afundar - sua total insignificância diante da vastidão do cosmos!
Apotheosis (Quest)#107.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#108.src: Ah... Her Majesty and the Spymaster, they held interest in you once. Looking upon you now, I simply cannot fathom why.
Apotheosis (Quest)#108.dst: Ah... Sua Majestade e a Mestra dos Espiões já se interessaram por você. Olhando agora, simplesmente não entendo por quê.
Apotheosis (Quest)#108.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#109.src: But I suppose it matters not! You have certainly cut that strand of interest with all your assorted antics, haven't you?
Apotheosis (Quest)#109.dst: Mas suponho que não importa! Você certamente cortou esse fio de interesse com suas diversas travessuras, não?
Apotheosis (Quest)#109.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#110.src: Well! If you must die, be glad it was to my blade! LET THE SHOW BEGIN!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#110.dst: Bem! Se vai morrer, que seja pela minha lâmina! QUE COMECE O SHOW!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#110.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#111.src: Flooding the whole forest... There's- That can't be, th-there's no way...
Apotheosis (Quest)#111.dst: Inundar a floresta inteira... Isso- Não pode ser, n-não tem como...
Apotheosis (Quest)#111.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Apotheosis (Quest)#112.src: I certainly hope you've learned your lesson, Rose! This is what happens! Loose nails get hammered down!
Apotheosis (Quest)#112.dst: Espero que tenha aprendido a lição, Rosa! É isso que acontece! Prego que se destaca leva martelada!
Apotheosis (Quest)#112.speaker: Dusk Garden

Apotheosis (Quest)#114.src: This is all happening because a certain SOMEONE incited violence against the crown! In the papers no less, where we do our work!
Apotheosis (Quest)#114.dst: Isso tudo está acontecendo porque CERTA PESSOA incitou violência contra a coroa! E no jornal, onde trabalhamos!
Apotheosis (Quest)#114.speaker: Dusk Garden

Apotheosis (Quest)#115.src: Risky, dangerous, all of it- and now look where we are! Public executions! We might not even be allowed to publish after this!
Apotheosis (Quest)#115.dst: Arriscado, perigoso, tudo isso- e olha onde estamos! Execuções públicas! Talvez nem nos deixem publicar depois disso!
Apotheosis (Quest)#115.speaker: Dusk Garden

Apotheosis (Quest)#116.src: ...there are...HOW many people in danger right now, a-and all you can think to do is-
Apotheosis (Quest)#116.dst: ...tem...QUANTAS pessoas em perigo agora, e-e tudo o que você pensa em fazer é-
Apotheosis (Quest)#116.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Apotheosis (Quest)#118.src: How can you be so monumentally stupid?! At least they TRIED! At least they SHOWED UP! They followed through!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#118.dst: Como pode ser tão absurdamente burro?! Pelo menos eles TENTARAM! Pelo menos APARECERAM! Foram até o fim!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#118.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Apotheosis (Quest)#119.src: The first hope I've seen in years, and you throw petty insults at them?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#119.dst: A primeira esperança em anos, e você joga insultos mesquinhos neles?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#119.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Apotheosis (Quest)#120.src: Ergh...where did you learn to hit?! Can you really only rely on that to make your point?
Apotheosis (Quest)#120.dst: Argh...onde aprendeu a bater?! Só sabe defender suas ideias assim?
Apotheosis (Quest)#120.speaker: Dusk Garden

Apotheosis (Quest)#121.src: Oh, grow UP already!! Think of something useful to do, instead of looking at the people who are doing anything more than sitting on their asses and going ''how uncivilized!''
Apotheosis (Quest)#121.dst: Ah, CRESÇA de uma vez!! Pense em algo útil, em vez de olhar torto para quem faz mais que ficar sentado no traseiro dizendo ''que incivilizado!''
Apotheosis (Quest)#121.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Apotheosis (Quest)#122.src: Hey, language! And besides, it's not as if that insurgent has any chance against-
Apotheosis (Quest)#122.dst: Ei, olha a boca! Além disso, não é como se aquele insurgente tivesse chance contra-
Apotheosis (Quest)#122.speaker: Dusk Garden

Apotheosis (Quest)#126.src: ...The Sovereign...is dead!! The Resistance is triumphant!! Can't you see?! They were right!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#126.dst: ...O Soberano...morreu!! A Resistência triunfou!! Não vê?! Eles tinham razão!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#126.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Apotheosis (Quest)#127.src: We need to help them! This might be our only chance, we can't let it slip away from us!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#127.dst: Temos que ajudá-los! Pode ser nossa única chance, não podemos deixá-la escapar!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#127.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Apotheosis (Quest)#133.src: MAJIN'S DEAD, WHAT CAN THEY DO NOW?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#133.dst: MAJIN MORREU, O QUE ELES FARÃO?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#133.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Apotheosis (Quest)#134.src: You! You really did it!! People are...they're doing something!! It worked, I can't believe it worked!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#134.dst: Você! Você conseguiu mesmo!! As pessoas estão...fazendo algo!! Funcionou, não acredito que funcionou!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#134.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Apotheosis (Quest)#135.src: I'm going with them! We have to keep up the momentum, m-maybe I can direct them! You do whatever you have to- I trust you! We'll make it!
Apotheosis (Quest)#135.dst: Vou com eles! Precisamos manter o embalo, t-talvez eu consiga guiá-los! Faça o que tiver que fazer- confio em você! Vamos conseguir!
Apotheosis (Quest)#135.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Apotheosis (Quest)#139.src: Good. That's one less Sovereign to worry about...
Apotheosis (Quest)#139.dst: Bom. Um Soberano a menos com que se preocupar...
Apotheosis (Quest)#139.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#141.src: She... she really threatened to flood the {p}... didn't she...?
Apotheosis (Quest)#141.dst: Ela... ela ameaçou mesmo inundar {p}... não foi...?
Apotheosis (Quest)#141.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#142.src: I- I- I can't believe it... all be- because we won't b...back down?
Apotheosis (Quest)#142.dst: N- n- não acredito... tudo p- porque não vamos r...recuar?
Apotheosis (Quest)#142.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#143.src: Well, I can. Just like the New Age... ugh, was THAT her too?! We're unprepared, outmatched... how are we meant to-
Apotheosis (Quest)#143.dst: Eu acredito. Igual à Nova Era... argh, ISSO também foi ela?! Despreparados, em desvantagem... como vamos-
Apotheosis (Quest)#143.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#144.src: It doesn't matter! We- we have to stop her! We can't just... let her kill all those people!
Apotheosis (Quest)#144.dst: Não importa! A- a gente precisa detê-la! Não dá para... deixar que ela mate toda essa gente!
Apotheosis (Quest)#144.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#145.src: ...I hate it, but you're right. Come on, let's-
Apotheosis (Quest)#145.dst: ...odeio isso, mas tem razão. Vamos, vamos-
Apotheosis (Quest)#145.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#146.src: Phew- you're all still standing strong!! Good, good... I- phew- I was getting worried!
Apotheosis (Quest)#146.dst: Ufa- vocês ainda estão firmes!! Bom, bom... eu- ufa- já estava ficando preocupado!
Apotheosis (Quest)#146.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#147.src: R...Rurie? What are you doing h- here?
Apotheosis (Quest)#147.dst: R...Rurie? O que faz a- aqui?
Apotheosis (Quest)#147.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#148.src: Ah! One moment, just, ha, allow me to catch my breath- let me tell you, those speed talismans are handy but they really leave you winded-
Apotheosis (Quest)#148.dst: Ah! Um momento, só, ha, deixem-me recuperar o fôlego- vou dizer, esses talismãs de velocidade são úteis, mas deixam a gente sem ar-
Apotheosis (Quest)#148.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#149.src: ...ohohohoho, do my eyes deceive me?! I'd heard the townsfolk talking but I could hardly believe it- is it really true? Has the Sovereign Thalas truly been felled?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#149.dst: ...ohohohoho, meus olhos me enganam?! Ouvi o povo falando, mas mal podia crer- é verdade mesmo? O Soberano Thalas caiu de verdade?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#149.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#152.src: Good! Great, even! Got what he deserved, in the end!
Apotheosis (Quest)#152.dst: Bom! Ótimo, até! No fim, teve o que merecia!
Apotheosis (Quest)#152.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#153.src: Hm? No, it's perfectly normal. If you had the vendetta I had, then, well! You would react likewise, I'm certain.
Apotheosis (Quest)#153.dst: Hm? Não, é perfeitamente normal. Se tivessem a mesma rixa que eu, bem! Reagiriam igual, tenho certeza.
Apotheosis (Quest)#153.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#155.src: Dead! Dead! He's dead, and I'm not, and I win! Hahahahaha!
Apotheosis (Quest)#155.dst: Morto! Morto! Ele morreu, eu não, e eu venci! Hahahahaha!
Apotheosis (Quest)#155.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#157.src: Problems! Right! Right right right right right!! That's why I'm here, after all- haha, apologies, got distracted a moment...
Apotheosis (Quest)#157.dst: Problemas! Certo! Certo certo certo certo certo!! É por isso que vim, afinal- haha, perdão, me distraí um instante...
Apotheosis (Quest)#157.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#158.src: It seems the crown's finally recovered from the shock, and attacks on the safe zone have increased in strength and frequency!
Apotheosis (Quest)#158.dst: Parece que a coroa enfim se recuperou do choque, e os ataques à zona segura estão mais fortes e frequentes!
Apotheosis (Quest)#158.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#159.src: She sent me to... well, to check and see if you're alive, firstly - but also to bring whoever I can back to support the defense effort!
Apotheosis (Quest)#159.dst: Ela me mandou... bem, primeiro ver se vocês estão vivos - mas também levar de volta quem eu puder para reforçar a defesa!
Apotheosis (Quest)#159.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#160.src: We have issues here too, Rurie. The Queen has just publicly announced she's going to FLOOD the {p}!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#160.dst: Aqui também temos problemas, Rurie. A Rainha acabou de anunciar em público que vai INUNDAR {p}!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#160.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#161.src: Oh! Oh, dear! That isn't good at all! We've truly driven her far enough to warrant such an act?
Apotheosis (Quest)#161.dst: Oh! Oh, céus! Isso não é nada bom! Nós a levamos mesmo tão longe a ponto disso?
Apotheosis (Quest)#161.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#162.src: Rurie, I'll g- go with you. I... I need to m...make sure Yuman's safe.
Apotheosis (Quest)#162.dst: Rurie, eu v- vou com você. P...preciso ver se Yuman está bem.
Apotheosis (Quest)#162.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#164.src: Rex, Sui, {u}... I- I want to h...help you, but-
Apotheosis (Quest)#164.dst: Rex, Sui, {u}... Eu- eu quero a...ajudar, mas-
Apotheosis (Quest)#164.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#165.src: Hey, Zeph, it's alright. Make sure there's a resistance still standing for us to rejoin when it's all over, alright?
Apotheosis (Quest)#165.dst: Ei, Zeph, tudo bem. Garanta que haja uma resistência de pé para a gente voltar quando acabar, tá?
Apotheosis (Quest)#165.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#167.src: Y- you guys too! Let's reunite wh...when this is all over, alright?
Apotheosis (Quest)#167.dst: V- vocês também! Vamos nos reencontrar q...quando tudo acabar, tá?
Apotheosis (Quest)#167.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#168.src: Then it's settled! Good luck, you three! Go show the Queen what you've got!
Apotheosis (Quest)#168.dst: Decidido! Boa sorte, vocês três! Mostrem à Rainha do que são capazes!
Apotheosis (Quest)#168.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#169.src: Head to the dam and stop the Queen at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Apotheosis (Quest)#169.dst: Vá até a represa e detenha a Rainha em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Apotheosis (Quest)#171.src: Necessary? Very little ever is. But it will prove a point.
Apotheosis (Quest)#171.dst: Necessário? Pouca coisa é. Mas servirá de lição.
Apotheosis (Quest)#171.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#172.src: Really. Thousands of lives... to prove a point.
Apotheosis (Quest)#172.dst: Sei. Milhares de vidas... para dar uma lição.
Apotheosis (Quest)#172.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#173.src: You understand the stakes of the greater task, yes? If that end is not averted, they die regardless. Them, and everyone else.
Apotheosis (Quest)#173.dst: Entende o que está em jogo na tarefa maior? Se aquele fim não for evitado, morrem de todo jeito. Eles e todos os outros.
Apotheosis (Quest)#173.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#174.src: And without order here, we will lack the focus to see it through. So, see it as a necessary evil. Nothing more, nothing less.
Apotheosis (Quest)#174.dst: E sem ordem aqui, faltará foco para levá-la a cabo. Então veja como um mal necessário. Nada mais, nada menos.
Apotheosis (Quest)#174.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#176.src: She will come around. She always does, in the end.
Apotheosis (Quest)#176.dst: Ela vai ceder. Sempre cede, no fim.
Apotheosis (Quest)#176.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#178.src: I don't like this. There are better opt-
Apotheosis (Quest)#178.dst: Não gosto disso. Há opções melh-
Apotheosis (Quest)#178.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#179.src: You do not have to like it, Sovereign. But if you wish to make change for the world, you will have to see it through.
Apotheosis (Quest)#179.dst: Não precisa gostar, Soberano. Mas se quer mudar o mundo, terá de ir até o fim.
Apotheosis (Quest)#179.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#182.src: We won't let you go through with this!
Apotheosis (Quest)#182.dst: Não vamos deixar você fazer isso!
Apotheosis (Quest)#182.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#184.src: Good grief, are my Sovereigns truly good for NOTHING?! Zhiraok, Soosu, Gikyo, Majin - each and every one a FAILURE!
Apotheosis (Quest)#184.dst: Francamente, meus Soberanos NÃO servem para NADA?! Zhiraok, Soosu, Gikyo, Majin - cada um deles um FRACASSO!
Apotheosis (Quest)#184.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#185.src: Oh, what does it matter?! All of this - everything you have done, everything you have caused, all will be swept away and FORGOTTEN once I am finished with you!
Apotheosis (Quest)#185.dst: Ah, que importa?! Tudo isto - tudo o que fizeram, tudo o que causaram, será varrido e ESQUECIDO quando eu acabar com vocês!
Apotheosis (Quest)#185.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#187.src: Why are you doing this?! Why are you LETTING her kill all those people?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#187.dst: Por que está fazendo isso?! Por que DEIXA ela matar toda essa gente?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#187.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#190.src: What?! You ALWAYS have a choice, du-
Apotheosis (Quest)#190.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#191.src: Stop trying to talk to him. We have to-...!
Apotheosis (Quest)#191.dst: Pare de falar com ele. Temos que-...!
Apotheosis (Quest)#191.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#194.src: We have to stop her before she tears this whole thing down!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#194.dst: Temos que detê-la antes que ela derrube tudo isso!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#194.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#195.src: I can't let you do that.
Apotheosis (Quest)#195.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#196.src: Ugh... we're getting nowhere! We NEED to find a way to stop the Queen!
Apotheosis (Quest)#196.dst: Argh... não saímos do lugar! PRECISAMOS achar um jeito de deter a Rainha!
Apotheosis (Quest)#196.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#198.src: Ha! Didn't expect that one, did you?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#198.dst: Ha! Essa você não esperava, hein?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#198.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#201.src: {u}! Her spell's down, but- she'll get it back up if we don't keep her busy!
Apotheosis (Quest)#201.dst: {u}! O feitiço dela caiu, mas- ela vai refazê-lo se não a mantivermos ocupada!
Apotheosis (Quest)#201.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#202.src: I'll handle Tasim! Go!! You're the only one of us who stands a chance against her!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#202.dst: Eu cuido do Tasim! Vai!! Você é o único de nós com chance contra ela!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#202.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#206.src: So it would seem I cannot rely on my Sovereigns for anything!
Apotheosis (Quest)#206.dst: Pelo visto não posso contar com meus Soberanos para nada!
Apotheosis (Quest)#206.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#207.src: Perhaps I have not paid you quite enough attention. With each and every additional slight, you cement yourself as more and more of a threat.
Apotheosis (Quest)#207.dst: Talvez eu não tenha lhe dado atenção suficiente. A cada nova afronta, você se firma cada vez mais como uma ameaça.
Apotheosis (Quest)#207.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#208.src: Very well. Then I will do what I should have from the start, and deal with you MYSELF.
Apotheosis (Quest)#208.dst: Muito bem. Então farei o que devia ter feito desde o início e cuidarei de você EU MESMA.
Apotheosis (Quest)#208.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#210.src: Urgh... I see... ahahahaha, I see now...! I had underestimated you, after all!
Apotheosis (Quest)#210.dst: Argh... entendo... ahahahaha, agora entendo...! Eu o subestimei, afinal!
Apotheosis (Quest)#210.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#211.src: But I am not done just yet.
Apotheosis (Quest)#211.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#212.src: You... you... you have ruined everything. This shell is on the verge of collapsing under the strain... and this- this!- is not so easily repaired. And now... and now. Only one path remains.
Apotheosis (Quest)#212.dst: Você... você... você arruinou tudo. Esta casca está prestes a ruir sob a tensão... e isto- isto!- não se conserta tão fácil. E agora... e agora. Só resta um caminho.
Apotheosis (Quest)#212.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#213.src: That damned girl... if she had only done as she had been tasked... repair might - might - have been an option. As once before, the strands wrapped tightly against this burning, broken spark!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#213.dst: Aquela maldita garota... se tivesse feito o que lhe mandaram... o reparo poderia - poderia - ter sido possível. Como antes, os fios apertados contra esta centelha ardente e partida!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#213.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#214.src: But, no. No. Once again, the Weave is beyond my reach... And that was your doing as well, wasn't it?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#214.dst: Mas não. Não. Mais uma vez, a Trama está fora do meu alcance... E isso também foi obra sua, não foi?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#214.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#215.src: Ha... haha... ahahahahaha! Centuries of carefully constructing this visage, this freedom, of building a perfect kingdom, a perfect world, all gone to waste!!! Because. Of. YOU.
Apotheosis (Quest)#215.dst: Ha... haha... ahahahahaha! Séculos construindo com cuidado este semblante, esta liberdade, um reino perfeito, um mundo perfeito, tudo jogado fora!!! Por. Sua. CULPA.
Apotheosis (Quest)#215.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#216.src: Are you pleased? Oh, you must be. You believe this petty act of rebellion will solve every single one of your perceived problems?
Apotheosis (Quest)#216.dst: Está satisfeito? Ah, deve estar. Acha que esse ato mesquinho de rebeldia vai resolver cada um dos seus supostos problemas?
Apotheosis (Quest)#216.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#217.src: No. No, it will do no such thing. It has only made it worse.
Apotheosis (Quest)#217.dst: Não. Não, não fará nada disso. Só piorou tudo.
Apotheosis (Quest)#217.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#218.src: But you will not live to see it, will you? No... no, you will not. The shell will crack and strain and break, and you alongside it!
Apotheosis (Quest)#218.dst: Mas você não viverá para ver, não é? Não... não, não viverá. A casca vai rachar, ceder e quebrar, e você junto com ela!
Apotheosis (Quest)#218.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#219.src: One final satisfaction! Before all comes crashing down. I will enjoy it, {u}!
Apotheosis (Quest)#219.dst: Uma última satisfação! Antes que tudo desabe. Vou aproveitar, {u}!
Apotheosis (Quest)#219.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#222.src: This grapple arrow had better work...
Apotheosis (Quest)#222.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#223.src: HOW. DARE. YOU!? Insolent CHILD, you are nothing, NOTHING compared to- urgh...
Apotheosis (Quest)#223.dst: COMO. OUSA!? CRIANÇA insolente, você não é nada, NADA perto de- argh...
Apotheosis (Quest)#223.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#224.src: Oh, what does it matter?! Death will claim you all the same, once worlds SHATTER and hellfire rains down from above...
Apotheosis (Quest)#224.dst: Ah, que importa?! A morte levará vocês do mesmo jeito, quando os mundos se PARTIREM e o fogo infernal chover do alto...
Apotheosis (Quest)#224.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#225.src: This... this will be difficult to bury. But not impossible.
Apotheosis (Quest)#225.dst: Isto... isto vai ser difícil de enterrar. Mas não impossível.
Apotheosis (Quest)#225.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#227.src: And all of it just... breaks, in the end, anyway... doesn't it.
Apotheosis (Quest)#227.dst: E tudo só... se quebra, no fim, de todo jeito... não é.
Apotheosis (Quest)#227.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#228.src: Sigh... what was the point of it all?
Apotheosis (Quest)#228.dst: Suspiro... qual era o sentido de tudo?
Apotheosis (Quest)#228.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#229.src: I didn't... I didn't want for this to happen. I just...
Apotheosis (Quest)#229.dst: Eu não... eu não queria que isso acontecesse. Eu só...
Apotheosis (Quest)#229.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#233.src: We've reached the end, and I chose the wrong side. Stuck by a cause I was too stubborn to drop...
Apotheosis (Quest)#233.dst: Chegamos ao fim, e escolhi o lado errado. Preso a uma causa que fui teimoso demais para largar...
Apotheosis (Quest)#233.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#234.src: And you've proven very efficient at killing those in the wrong, haven't you?
Apotheosis (Quest)#234.dst: E você provou ser bem eficiente em matar quem está errado, não é?
Apotheosis (Quest)#234.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#235.src: I've gone too far. I know. I know I have. Call it whatever you want, I just- I...
Apotheosis (Quest)#235.dst: Fui longe demais. Eu sei. Sei que fui. Chame como quiser, eu só- eu...
Apotheosis (Quest)#235.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#236.src: It doesn't matter. We're here now. You have to do it.
Apotheosis (Quest)#236.dst: Não importa. Estamos aqui. Você tem que fazer isso.
Apotheosis (Quest)#236.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#237.src: I made my choices. I knew where they were leading me, and... and I didn't turn away. Now, we've reached the end. You have to kill me.
Apotheosis (Quest)#237.dst: Fiz minhas escolhas. Sabia aonde me levavam, e... e não desviei. Agora chegamos ao fim. Você tem que me matar.
Apotheosis (Quest)#237.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#238.src: What even is there left for me? Where would I go? Is there anyone, any place left? I don't have anything.
Apotheosis (Quest)#238.dst: O que ainda resta para mim? Aonde eu iria? Resta alguém, algum lugar? Eu não tenho nada.
Apotheosis (Quest)#238.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#239.src: Just... let me be with him. Give me that one thing. That's all.
Apotheosis (Quest)#239.dst: Só... me deixe ficar com ele. Me dê só isso. É tudo.
Apotheosis (Quest)#239.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#244.src: ...like Aledar. When you said it was a sacrifice, you... he... he really...?
Apotheosis (Quest)#244.dst: ...como Aledar. Quando disse que foi sacrifício, você... ele... ele...?
Apotheosis (Quest)#244.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#248.src: Ha... even after all this? You still...
Apotheosis (Quest)#248.dst: Ha... depois disso tudo? Você ainda...
Apotheosis (Quest)#248.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#249.src: ... Okay. Okay. If- if you're sure. What am I- what was I thinking...?
Apotheosis (Quest)#249.dst: ... Tá. Tá. Se- se tem certeza. O que eu- no que eu estava pensando...?
Apotheosis (Quest)#249.speaker: Sovereign Tasim
